name: RS social media follow link adder
author: Rajkumar

sections.description:
RS social media follow link adder automatically appends a responsive block of social channel buttons to single posts and provides a shortcode to place the same block anywhere. A settings page lets site admins set a heading and paste channel URLs; empty fields are ignored so only active channels appear. [attached_file:2]

Key features:
– Auto-inserts buttons on single posts with an optional heading. [attached_file:2]
– Shortcode [rkp_channel_links] for use in pages, widgets, or templates. [attached_file:2]
– Per-network colors with accessible contrast and security-conscious links (rel="noopener noreferrer"). [attached_file:2]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rkp-channel-links folder to /wp-content/plugins/. [attached_file:2]
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen. [attached_file:2]
  3. Go to Settings → RS social media follow link adder and enter channel URLs. [attached_file:2]
sections.faq:
Can the buttons be shown on pages?

Yes. Use the shortcode [rkp_channel_links] wherever needed. [attached_file:2]

Will empty inputs output buttons?

No. Only channels with valid, non-empty URLs are rendered. [attached_file:2]

Can the heading be customized?

Yes. The heading text can be changed on the settings page; it is escaped before output. [attached_file:2]
